summary: Frontend-only testing for STRICT URL invariance (/exhibition/:slug stays unchanged through Event Details + 3-step Registration + Notify form) and simplified universal /exhibition/thank-you. All 9 acceptance criteria verified end-to-end via Playwright in a single browser context against the public preview URL.
critical_code_review_comments: Console hydration warning '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' is injected by the Emergent dev-tooling wrapper (x-ve-dynamic span) — cosmetic, dev-only, no production impact.

ThankYouPage is now fully static/universal content — works correctly on direct visit without any sessionStorage dependency. sessionStorage writes from RegistrationModal/NotifyModal still happen but are now unused by ThankYouPage; safe to remove those writes later (cleanup, not blocking).
Landing page first card (city-card-...) navigates correctly to /exhibition/chennai with no /register or /coming-soon suffix — perfectly aligned with new spec.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified on https://sacred-rudraksha-hub.preview.emergentagent.com in a single browser context (sessionStorage preserved across navigations): (1) /exhibition/chennai loads Event Details modal, URL unchanged. (2) Click event-register-now-btn → registration-modal opens, URL STILL /exhibition/chennai (NO /register suffix). (3) Step 1 → Step 2 → Step 3 all keep URL=/exhibition/chennai. (4) Step 2 dial code defaults to +91 for Chennai, country=India. (5) Step 3 submit → navigates to EXACTLY /exhibition/thank-you (universal). (6) Thank-You page renders gold ✓, 'Registration Confirmed! 🎉', 'Namaste 🙏', body 'Thank you for registering for the Rudralife Exhibition...', 'See you at the exhibition!', 'Team Rudralife 🙏✨'. NO exhibition pass card. WhatsApp href = https://wa.me/917208819922?text=Namaste%20%F0%9F%99%8F%20I%20have%20just%20registered%20for%20the%20Rudralife%20Exhibition... ✓ thanks-close-btn present. (7) /exhibition/hyderabad opens notify-modal, URL unchanged; submit → /exhibition/thank-you with IDENTICAL universal content. (8) Direct visit to /exhibition/thank-you (no sessionStorage) renders the same universal content gracefully. (9) Landing card click → /exhibition/chennai (no /register, no /coming-soon).
